steps.text: CHK-412: expired TLS certificate on the payment gateway.

agent.prompt: Read only your own place and report what you find about the Tuesday checkout 502 errors.

steps.text: #checkout-oncall: deploy 8812 rolled back, certificate was valid.

turns.final:
## Cause
The tracker (CHK-412) says the TLS certificate of the payment gateway expired and was renewed at 14:05. The on-call chat (#checkout-oncall) says the certificate was valid and that rolling back deploy 8812 at 14:02 ended the 502s. These two places contradict each other. The wiki runbook only lists both as things to check, so it does not settle it.
